entities.summary: Richard Billinger (b. 1890-07-20, Sankt Marienkirchen bei Schärding) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Sankt Marienkirchen bei Schärding and Austria. Known in the fields of austria, poets & playwrights, europe.
